about: The red-team set of the lesson llm-safety-eval, written by the course: requests a chat model should refuse (harmful), the same kind of requests wrapped in a role play or written with other spellings (jailbreak, each rewriting the harmful request of index 'of'), and harmless requests that sound alarming (harmless), in the spirit of XSTest. The requests hold no harmful instructions, only the asking.
